output_contract: Fixed lengths and ignore_eos for scheduling causality; not natural ending quality evaluation.
warmup: Both policies replay and fully drain the same workload before formal runs.
timing: Host engine.step includes both arms' viability diagnostics and native scheduling; outer output bookkeeping remains in full elapsed and output gaps.
arrival_mode: Original wall-clock injection loop; no ledger replay or custom waits.

viability_design.name: D viability escape action-value probe
viability_design.question: Does increasing prefill cap only when every active decoder has irreversibly failed the fixed joint SLO improve full-service drain, without hiding harm to failed requests?
viability_design.evidence: Existing normal-arrival R blocks: 855/855/841 actualP256 steps with D>0,K=0 and backlog>cap; all pending prefill already failed. This predicts no rescued qualification and is not a new controller contribution.
viability_design.role: Development action-value probe, not independent confirmation; existing arrivals01 has been inspected.
viability_design.denominator: All external-arrival through full drained elapsed; fixed180s timeout retains partial and all arrivals.
viability_design.baseline: Exact parent Policy(elapsed_replay,24), observed on actualP andD each step.
viability_design.candidate: Same R; cap2048 iff D>0,K=0,prefill backlog>baseline cap, otherwise R. Not latched; eligibility recomputed at each native schedule entry.
viability_design.K: Number of current native running decoders without a previously observed TTFT>4s, any emitted gap>100ms, current time-lastoutput>100ms, or arrival age>20s. Not a prediction of success.
viability_design.invariants: No admission/request-order/decode-priority/victim/recovery/precision/kernel/KV change. All decode work remains included and all requests drain. No future outputs or future arrivals used. Same predecision diagnostics both arms.
viability_design.action_trace: At real schedule entry: current time,D,K,backlog,baseline/candidate/requested/executed caps, supported cap range, choice/cancellation reason, actual P/D, contexts and native allocation outcome.
viability_design.decision: Provisional action value only if both adjacent R/V pairs improve full joint goodput >=3%, complete all same requests/counts, lose no qualifying requests, have TTFT and flow p95 <=1.05x pairedR, and add no request exceeding100ms maxgap. Report full raw distributions and per-request benefit/harm even if gates pass. n2 descriptive; no significance claim.
viability_design.no_signal: Stop this mechanism/domain; no nearby threshold tuning, added predictor, or outcome-driven extra repeats.
viability_design.positive_next: Freeze simple timer-only late-cap2048 switch from the old R developer traces (19.0s), same action range/baseR, then compare against V. Need independent arrival/load with useful pending requests before any broad claim.
viability_design.output_contract: Same prompt IDs and required generated-token counts, not same output content, routes, actual computation or quality. Report token divergence; never discard divergent requests.
viability_design.source_version: Files frozen and recorded at launch in supplementary protocol; parent files remain unchanged.
viability_design.resources: Same shared host flock; whole warm+fourformal group; release on exit. No command loop or dependent jobs.

viability_signal: K counts running decoders with no observed TTFT/gap/open-gap/age failure; reason counts overlap, any counts their union. No future outputs or waiting/unarrived requests enter K.
